title: Towards Generalized Dimers for GTPs: $\mathcal{N}=2$ Fractional Branes at Infinite Coupling
summary: Generalized Toric Polygons (GTPs) extend the geometric realization of $5d$ superconformal field theories beyond toric Calabi-Yau 3-folds to general $(p,q)$ 5-brane webs ending on 7-branes. We take significant steps towards the generalization of brane tilings for GTPs, or equivalently, the corresponding quiver theories. We focus on GTPs connected to ordinary toric diagrams by polytope mutations.
